info.title: Freightnaut Docs
info.description: Server-side session authentication and tenant-scoped APIs. Mutations require the exact configured Origin and X-CSRF-Token from /api/auth/session. Production cookie name is __Host-freightnaut_session; local HTTP development omits the __Host- prefix. No live issuance endpoint exists.
